answer: To blunt Sybil floods, each new agent posts a bonded deposit that sits on a ledge until it has mined and graded across several epochs; early exit burns a growing fraction. Peer weight grows like an orchard: only identities that countersign verifiable work keep branches alive, so empty clones wither without attestations. Voting power uses an economic anchor tied to spendable history and burned stake, so minting fake accounts multiplies capital loss instead of influence.
